limitations: This is post-hoc design work; it cannot admit, replace, repair or discard any historical failed run.
The 6000 events come from exp case6 only, with diagnostic instrumentation and one long formal phase. They do not reproduce three primed phases or 40 heterogeneous cases.
Overlapping windows are dependent. Monte Carlo repetition reduces simulation error, not uncertainty about the unknown hardware distribution.
40-case calculations assume independent identically distributed cases only for sensitivity. No calibrated family-wise false rejection claim is made.
All samples, including tails, are retained. Pooled full-corpus stability does not make a random 30-pair sample stable.
Longer ACL-event repeat counts change the burst horizon and may change queue/cache/thermal behavior. Arithmetic dilution examples do not prove actual hardware improvement.
source: All 6 fresh-process cycles, all 500 pairs/cycle, both roles; no exclusions or winsorization.
